senses.gloss: f. (דור, דרר, v. דְּרוֹר) freedom, remission of tribute or fine, pardon.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53:8">Gen. R. s. 53</cite> (play on <he>י̇צ̇ח̇ק̇</he>) [read:] <he>י̇צ̇א ח̇וק̇ לעולם ליתן דו׳ לעולם</he> a law was issued to give a grant (remission of sin) &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 92:2">Yalk. ib. 92</cite> <he>יצא חוק דרור׳ וכ׳</he>. Gen. R. l. c. [read:] <he>מה עשייה … ליתן ד׳ לעולם אף עשייה … ליתן ד׳ לעולם</he> as the verb <he>עשה</he> used there (<cite ref="Esther 2:18">Esth. II, 18</cite>) means to grant a remission to the world, so does the verb <he>עשה</he> (<cite ref="Genesis 21:8">Gen. XXI, 8</cite>) etc.; Pesik. Sos, p. 146ᵃ <cite ref="D00378"><he>דורניא</he></cite> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 93:1">Yalk. Gen. 93</cite> <he>דרור׳</he>.—Y’lamd. to Lev. XXI, 10, quot. in Ar. <he>ד׳ שלימה</he> full pardon.
